method.aggregation: Only authorized signed dollar flow is netted by symbol for the market step. Per-order eligibility and budget/portfolio reservations are never aggregated.
method.authority: Every emitted order receives one individual orderguard_arena.authority.Authority decision.
method.impact: Square-root temporary impact with exponential decay; no order book, latency queue, or execution venue simulation.
method.order_activity: Population state is vectorized; only sparse active orders are materialized. Activity probability is recorded in config.
method.risk: The shipped orderguard_risk RiskScorer scores gate-allowed orders in full; tighten() can only make them stricter.

scenario.description: Venue C misses an 8% repricing and remains eight steps stale for one symbol; the authority still trusts the median of three venues.
scenario.title: One stale venue
